# Next.js Admin Dashboard - Development Guide

## Project Overview
Next.js admin dashboard with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase authentication for admin role-based access control.

## Setup Progress
- [x] Project requirements clarified
- [x] Next.js project scaffolded with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
- [x] Supabase authentication integrated
- [x] Role-based access control implemented
- [x] Dependencies compiled
- [x] Development environment ready

## Key Technologies
- Next.js (latest)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase Auth
- React Hooks

## Development Notes
- Environment variables required: See .env.local
- Database migrations managed through Supabase dashboard
- Role-based middleware for admin routes
